name: moss_post_office_golden
prompt: Cozy woodland post office at golden dusk, a beautiful hand-painted children's storybook illustration for a browser game. Wide composition with key subjects kept inside the central 80% of the frame so it can crop safely. A charming small post-office cottage slightly right of center with a rounded moss-covered roof, cream plaster walls, warm honey-lit arched windows, deep green arched door, crooked stone chimney with a soft curl of smoke, climbing ivy and flower boxes. A dusty-rose mailbox with a raised flag and a letter on the left, small stacked parcels, a tiny cute snail mail carrier with a satchel, and a small round rabbit postmaster in a patchwork apron waving from the door. A winding stone path from the bottom center to the cottage, lush ferns, mushrooms, wildflowers, a low wooden fence, hanging lanterns, glowing fireflies, and one paper airplane. Layered forest and rolling moss hills with soft mist, distant pine silhouettes, a dusk sky of muted teal, dusty lavender and peach, a thin crescent moon and scattered stars. Palette of moss green, warm cream, dusty rose, honey gold and lavender dusk. Hand-painted gouache and colored pencil with fine paper grain and soft screenprint texture, gentle warm rim light, whimsical, cozy, richly detailed but not busy, not photorealistic. No text, no writing, no signage with letters, no logo, no UI, no border, no watermark. Anatomically coherent cute animals, no duplicated limbs.

name: moss_post_office_hollow
prompt: A hidden woodland post office in a mossy hollow at blue-hour twilight, whimsical modern storybook illustration in painterly gouache and watercolor with visible paper grain and soft colored-pencil outlines. The cottage sits centrally, slightly below the horizon: a small crooked two-story cottage with a rounded moss and mushroom-like roof, cream plaster walls, glowing amber windows, a deep green arched door with a brass mail slot, a crooked brick chimney. Huge ancient trees frame the scene. A dusty-rose mailbox on a wooden post, letters, tied parcels, a round little bear postmaster carrying a leather mail sack, and a tiny snail with a letter. A winding ribbon of stepping stones leads from the foreground to the door. Hanging paper lanterns and tiny string lights warm the clearing; fireflies, soft mist, ferns, foxgloves and mushrooms; a little pond reflecting warm light and a paper airplane in the sky. A dusk sky in deep teal, plum and peach with a crescent moon and stars. Muted moss, cream, rose, honey and lavender palette. Whimsical, cozy, rich but gentle detail, cinematic warm light, not photorealistic. Keep the cottage and characters inside the central 80% of the frame. No text, no lettering, no signage, no UI, no border, no watermark. Anatomically coherent cute animals, no duplicated limbs.
